title: List of active Pakistan Navy vessels

rows: PNS Khalid (S137) PNS Saad (S138) PNS Hamza (S139)

Equipped with the French MESMA air independent propulsion (AIP) system. First submarine built at DCN in France while other two built at Karachi Shipyard and Engineering Works (KSEW) in Karachi, Pakistan under a transfer of technology agreement. All three Agosta-90Bs upgraded by Turkey's STM: PNS/M Hamza upgraded and delivered in 2021. PNS/M Khalid upgraded and delivered in December 2022.
Originally intended to be sold to South Africa, but sold to Pakistan after embargo on South Africa.

8 submarines on order, of which 3 have already been built and launched, and 1 (PNS Hangor) commissioned. First 4 being built in China by the China Shipbuilding Trading Company (CSOC) and last 4 being built in Pakistan by KSEW with technology transfer. First 4 submarines expected to be delivered by 2026, while last 4 expected to be delivered by 2028.
Mini-submarines designed by Italian firm COSMOS in 1986 and built in Pakistan by KSEW under a transfer of technology agreement.

PNS Tughril (F261) PNS Taimur (F262) PNS Tippu Sultan (F263) PNS Shah Jahan (F264)
First two ships commissioned in 2022 and two commissioned in 2023.
PNS Zulfiquar (F251) PNS Shamsheer (F252) PNS Saif (F253) PNS Aslat (F254)

F-22Ps based on updated Type 053H3 frigates. Design is also influenced from Type 054. The F-22P's hull contains Type 054 frigate's radar cross-section reduction. First three ships were constructed in China and the fourth ship was built in Pakistan by KSEW with transfer of technology.

The Jinnah class is Pakistan's first locally designed and built frigate. It was designed by the Pakistan Navy's Platform Design Wing (PDW), and a contract has been signed with KSEW to launch the first ship by 2028. Total 6-8 ships planned.
Based on Turkish MILGEM-class corvette. PNS Babur commissioned on 6 September 2024. PNS Khaiber handed over to the Pakistan Navy on 20 December 2025.
PNS Yarmook (F271) PNS Tabuk (F272) PNS Hunain (F273) PNS Yamama (F274)

Dutch shipbuilder Damen built PNS Yarmook was commissioned in February 2020. PNS Tabuk was commissioned on 12 November 2020. Batch-II ships are based on Damen OPV 2600. These ships are armed with AShM and anti-air systems. PNS Hunain was commissioned on 26 July 2024 while PNS Yamama was commissioned on 17 December 2024.

Based on Turkish MILGEM-class corvette. PNS Badr and PNS Tariq have been launched and are undergoing outfitting and sea trials. The PNS Badr is expected to be delivered by June 2026, while the PNS Tariq will be delivered in the first quarter of 2027.
